description: File a list of tasks in one call, such as the action items from meeting notes. Every item is checked as create_ticket checks one, and one bad item stops the whole batch before anything is written. Items go to the bottom of the Backlog in the order given; an item whose panel is icebox goes to the top of the Icebox, which the person has to ask for. Place one elsewhere afterwards with move_ticket. The reply says what happened to each item.

tickets.description: The tickets to file, in order

assignee_ids.description: User IDs to assign, from list_people

due_date.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD, on any ticket; it has to be in the future. Set one only when the person gives a date.

labels.description: Label names, as list_labels shows them

panel.description: Which panel the ticket goes in: the bottom of the Backlog when unset, the top of the Icebox when icebox, which the person has to ask for

points.description: Effort estimate in points (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8): how much work the ticket takes. Not a time estimate, and not a rating of how complex or difficult the work is. Every ticket has points before it starts: estimate them yourself, or use the person's number when they give one.

project_id.description: Project external ID to assign to

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: create_tickets
title: Create several tickets
